description: This file defines multiple FastAPI endpoints related to public resources in the litellm project, including model hubs, agent hubs, MCP servers, provider info, and model cost maps.

methods.name: public_model_hub
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve model groups for the public model hub.

methods.name: get_agents
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve list of public agents.

methods.name: get_mcp_servers
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve list of MCP public servers.

methods.name: public_model_hub_info
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve information about the public model hub.

methods.name: get_supported_providers
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a sorted list of supported providers.

methods.name: get_provider_fields
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve provider creation fields metadata.

methods.name: get_litellm_model_cost_map
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the LiteLLM model cost map.

methods.name: get_agent_fields
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve agent creation fields, including inherited provider credentials.
